thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 10/11/2018: ATOM, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG, SQ

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 10/11/2018: ATOM, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG, SQ
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: -0.45%
AAPL: -0.68%
IBM: -0.52%
CSCO: -0.55%
GOOG: -0.30%
Technology stocks continued to decline in pre-market trading Thursday.
Among the stocks moving on news:
(-) Atomera ( ATOM ), which was down 19% after unveiling plans to offer and sell shares of its common stock in an underwritten public offering.
(-) Square ( SQ ) was trading 7.62% lower after Sarah Friar informed the company of her intention to step down as CFO in order to become CEO of Nextdoor.
In other sector news:
(-) Apple ( AAPL ) was 1.46% lower after Dialog Semiconductor unveiled an agreement to license certain power management technologies and transfer certain assets and over 300 employees to the iPhone maker to support chip research and development.
